Copyright (c) 2023 Polarice3. Licensed under MIT; the complete text is in LICENSE.txt.

Royal Guard model/textures also credit night.lxrd, as acknowledged by the upstream author. Other per-model credits and exact hashes are preserved in design/reference-models.json and SOURCES.json.

Selected geometry, textures and animation definitions were adapted for Dungeons Alive. The Goety game systems, audio and complete mod are not bundled. The imported source snapshots remain available to rebuild and inspect the adaptations.
